test_selection: One directed RV32 program executes the same cached instruction line in a 64-iteration loop, and six upstream RISC-V Architectural Tests provide additional complete-CPU execution. In cv32a60x, instruction-cache refill data and later cache hits pass through a 256-bit tc_sram instance in the technology-cut wrapper.

The recorded file is a blob in the parent CVA6 Git repository.
reconstruction.test_sources: checkout the recorded RISC-V Architectural Tests revision for the six named tests and copy ../sram_cache/harness/icache_sram_reuse.S, SHA-256 80e684d5bf77f25d31386a2f898ef50a24f4f0f41003fac6527dfb2b01cce4df, as the recorded directed test source

port_test.scope: After the unchanged seven CPU programs pass, exercise the single-port, one-cycle SRAM at the two cv32a60x geometries: 64 words of 25 bits and 64 words of 256 bits.
port_test.acceptance: Full and byte-masked writes, including the partial top byte of the 25-bit word, read back after one cycle, another address keeps its word, and SimInit none preserves written data through reset.
